headlines.title: “ 감독관 코앞서 AI 커닝 ”… 구멍 뚫린 국가자격시험 관리 [ AI 부정행위...
headlines.summary: 첨단기기 부정행위 취약한 현장감독 세무사 1·2차 수석자백으로 드러나 정부, 국가시험 전수조사 나섰지만 부정행위 제재·기관 간 공조 한계 16일 오전 서울의 한 매장에 소형카메라가 진열돼 있다.  윤창빈 기자 올해 세무사 시험 수석 합격자가 생성형 인공지능(AI)을 이용해 부정행위를 한 사실이 드러나면서 국가자격시험의 허술한 관리체계가 도마 위에 올랐다.

headlines.title: 한성숙 총리 " 수능 범정부 긴급 대응팀 구성…사후 점검체계도 강화"

key_headlines.title: Seoul Housing Purchase Sentiment Falls for 3rd Month While National Jeonse Market Hits Yearly High
key_headlines.summary: Seoul's housing transaction sentiment index declined for the third consecutive month to a 6-month low in October, while nationwide jeonse (long-term lease) sentiment rose for three consecutive months to reach the highest level of the year.

key_headlines.title: Seoul House Prices Show Downward Signals as Purchase Sentiment Drops, Supply Increases Over 20,000 Units
key_headlines.summary: With house purchase sentiment declining for three months straight, price declines that began in Gangnam three districts have spread to Songdong and Gangdong, accompanied by increased inventory in the market.

key_headlines.title: KDI Analysis: Semiconductor Productivity Rose 8.5% While Other Industries Declined 0.4%, Widening Wage Gap
key_headlines.summary: The Korea Development Institute found that semiconductor sector experienced significant productivity growth while other industries stagnated, with electronic component wages rising 9 percentage points higher than other sectors.

key_headlines.title: Households Owning Property Over 1.2 Billion Won Show Maximum Increase; Wealth Gap Between Top and Bottom 10% Reaches 52 Times
key_headlines.summary: In 2025, households owning properties exceeding 1.2 billion won increased by a maximum of 150,000 units, with wealth disparity between the richest and poorest 10% reaching an unprecedented 52-fold difference.

key_headlines.title: Government Forms Task Force to Address AI Cheating in Tax Accountant Exam, Announces Prevention Measures
key_headlines.summary: The government established an emergency task force involving the Ministry of Economy and Finance, National Tax Service, and private experts to address AI-related cheating in the certified tax accountant examination and implement preventive measures immediately.

sections.Hot Economy News: Seoul's housing market is experiencing a significant cooldown with purchase sentiment falling for the third consecutive month to a six-month low in October, while property listings have surged above 20,000 units. Notably, the price decline that originated in Seoul's Gangnam three districts has begun spreading to Songdong and Gangdong areas, signaling broader market weakness. In contrast, the nationwide jeonse (long-term lease) market sentiment is strengthening, reaching the highest level of the year as six out of ten brokerage offices report stronger demand than supply for lease properties. The divergence between Seoul's struggling transaction market and rising jeonse demand reflects shifting dynamics in the broader housing market.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: South Korea's economic fundamentals remain strong with projected growth of 3.3% and inflation at 2.7%, while exports are reaching record highs according to the Bank of Korea. However, despite these positive macro indicators, household purchasing power and actual living standards continue to deteriorate, raising questions about whether official statistics accurately reflect economic reality. Meanwhile, Japan's economy contracted in the third quarter with negative GDP growth of -0.1% annualized, driven by weakened consumption and increased crude oil import burdens, prompting the Bank of Japan to consider more aggressive monetary tightening. Regional banks in South Korea are facing mounting pressures as local economic downturns accelerate, with proposals to mandate public institutions deposit at least 30% of regional funds in local banks currently stalled.
sections.Financial Markets: The Korean stock market is showing signs of bottoming out with expectations of recovery, as long-only funds are resuming capital inflows following the recent sharp decline in Kospi. International investors view the market downturn as excessive adjustment, suggesting prices have approached floor levels. U.S. Treasury yields and oil prices have rebounded from their post-election lows, with the initial rate-cut effect from the Democratic sweep giving way to uncertainty regarding future monetary policy decisions. The December Federal Reserve meeting is gaining attention as a key variable, with markets currently favoring additional rate hikes over maintaining the current rate. Rising interest rates in Korea are constraining individual investor participation in equities, limiting additional upside potential for stock indices.
sections.Industry & Technology: South Korea and the Philippines agreed to deepen bilateral cooperation beyond defense industries to include shipbuilding, artificial intelligence, nuclear energy, space exploration, and disaster safety during a presidential summit. The global semiconductor sector faces uncertainty following leadership changes at major companies, with competition accelerating the transition timeline from Nvidia to alternative chips by three days, reducing Nvidia's GPU contract share to 39%. The United States is strengthening alliances in critical mineral and rare earth element supplies to reduce dependence on China, particularly for components essential to electric vehicles, robotics, and advanced weapons systems. SK On is reinforcing AI infrastructure by expanding GPU workforce capabilities to enhance operational efficiency in existing battery production facilities amid slowing EV market growth.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul's housing market is experiencing significant cooling with the monthly price increase rate dropping to 0.65% in October, the lowest level in six months, while price declines centered on Gangnam areas continue. In contrast, the Gyeonggi province market is showing triple strength with gains across sales, jeonse, and monthly lease markets as housing activity shifts away from Seoul. Jeonse deposit prices have risen 35% over six years while monthly rental rates hit a 46-month high with 2.1% increases, creating a double burden for renters as lending rates also climbed to 4.57%. The Korean Real Estate Marketing Association and Korean Housing Association signed a memorandum of understanding to collaborate on AI and digital transformation applications in housing market analysis and real estate marketing.
sections.International Economy: The U.S. Federal Reserve faces decisions on the magnitude of potential December rate increases, with this week's retail sales data and FOMC meeting minutes serving as key indicators for policy direction. Blackstone, the world's largest alternative investment firm, is preparing to enter South Korea's data center market as it bets on AI infrastructure development as a core growth area alongside Korean manufacturing capabilities. The Trump administration is signaling openness to diplomatic engagement, with President Trump mentioning the possibility of meeting North Korean leader Kim Jong Un during the upcoming APEC summit in China later this week. The U.S. continues to emphasize its preference for North Korean regime survival rather than expansionism similar to Iran's regional ambitions.
sections.AI & Economy: Global investors like Blackstone are aggressively pursuing AI infrastructure investments, recognizing that data center construction and power supply are foundational to AI-driven transformation. Jensen Huang's unexpected departure as Nvidia CEO has destabilized the AI chip market, with competitors accelerating their chip transition timelines and customers diversifying away from Nvidia's dominant CUDA platform, reducing Nvidia's GPU contract share to 39%. SK On and other Korean manufacturers are integrating AI infrastructure with production facilities to improve operational efficiency and cost competitiveness as EV demand growth slows. AI-driven business automation is becoming critical, with companies emphasizing the lasting competitive value of proprietary business data and operational procedures that remain with the organization regardless of AI technology changes.
sections.Others: The government faces ongoing debate about insufficient funding for firefighting services and public housing construction, with discussions about raising cigarette taxes after 11 years of price freeze to generate additional revenue for these essential services. The United States experienced its longest flight suspension period since 9/11 due to aging 60-year-old copper communication infrastructure, sparking political blame between the Trump and Biden administrations over responsibility for the outdated systems. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick faces potential conflict-of-interest concerns regarding his investment company's connections to Southeast Asian data center operators that may be involved in supplying AI semiconductor technology to China, circumventing U.S. export controls. Keepspharm achieved cumulative quarterly sales of 202.8 billion won through the third quarter, exceeding last year's full-year revenue of 170.1 billion won within nine months through pharmaceutical and biotech business expansion and successive M&A activities.
